responsibility: Implements the x86 AMX-INT8 intrinsic interface for integer tile dot-product operations. It conditionally enables the amx-int8 target and defines macro wrappers for the signed/unsigned mixed tile multiply-accumulate instructions such as _tile_dpbssd, _tile_dpbsud, _tile_dpbusd, and _tile_dpbuud, providing GCC’s public API for AMX int8 matrix arithmetic on x86_64.
